text:
alex: hey team — I'm oncall starting next Tue. quick checklist: who am I paired with for my first shadow, how do I run the pager test from my laptop, and where are the cliffnotes runbooks for triage? want to get setup and run one sim before my rotation.
taylor: welcome alex! i'm your shadow for week 1. add me on PagerDuty (taylor@redwood.com). i'll do a handoff at the start of your first shift and pair on the first incident.
riley: adding you to the oncall calendar now. for a local pager test (VPN required) run: 
```
curl -X POST https://ops-api.redwood.internal/v1/pager/test -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" -d '{"user":"alex","mode":"push"}'
```
OpsBot will post a simulated alert. if you get 403 check SSO role and ~/.redwood/credentials for id_token.
alex: tried the curl and got 403. i'm on corp VPN and SSO shows me logged in.
dana: 403 typically means the PD service role not granted. taylor, can you grant alex the "oncall-rotator" role? also confirm alex's phone is in PD as push + SMS.
taylor: done — granted oncall-rotator and synced contacts. alex, try again.
opsbot: OpsBot: test request received for alex. queued simulation, delivering in ~25s.
alex: got a push: "TEST ALERT — SIMULATION" on phone, PD app shows source ops-sim and device: iphone. looks good.
riley: great. scheduled a live tabletop sim tomorrow 09:30 PT (30min) — link: https://zoom.redwood.com/room/oncall-shadow. we'll walk triage, runbook lookup, escalation, and the postmortem checklist. bring your laptop.
alex: thanks. one more: for infra vs database P1s who do i notify first? and what's the expected ack timeline?
taylor: infra -> ping dana, db -> ping riley. expected ack for P1 is 5 minutes during business hours. if no ack in 10 minutes escalate to eng-sre channel and page oncall escalations. runbook excerpt: "P1: page primary -> 5m ack -> 10m escalate to eng-sre -> 20m exec notify".
dana: also enable SMS fallback in PD and set your escalation policy on the phone. if you want i can walk through toggling contact methods after the sim.
opsbot: OpsBot: pager test log 1822056789 — delivered via push to alex; status: delivered; ack: none.
alex: appreciate this — i'll join the zoom and am less anxious now :thumbsup: will message if the curl fails again.
